products.name: Sweet Mango Loncha
products.subtitle: Khandeshi Mango Loncha
products.tagline: Sweet, tangy and comforting — a beautiful balance inspired by homemade Khandeshi flavours.
products.tasteNote: The jaggery softens the sharpness of the kairi without covering it. You get the sweetness first, then the tang arrives a moment later, and the spices sit quietly underneath. It is the jar that children in the house finish fastest.
products.khandeshNote: In Khandeshi homes, a sweeter loncha is often kept aside for the youngest at the table and for guests who are not used to heat. This is that jar — the same batch, the same mangoes, simply balanced gently.

products.name: Medium Spicy Mango Loncha
products.subtitle: Khandeshi Mango Loncha
products.tagline: The perfect balance of tangy mango and traditional spices, with just the right amount of heat.
products.tasteNote: This is the everyday jar. Tangy mango leads, the spices follow warmly, and the heat settles rather than stings. If you are not sure which one to begin with, begin here.
products.khandeshNote: The jar that stays on the Khandeshi dining table all year. Not made for an occasion — made for Tuesday lunch, for a late dinner, for the meal you eat standing in the kitchen.

products.name: Spicy Mango Loncha
products.subtitle: Khandeshi Mango Loncha
products.tagline: Bold, spicy and full of character — for those who love a proper traditional Khandeshi kick.
products.tasteNote: Bold from the first bite. More chilli, a longer rest with the spices, and a finish that stays with you. A small spoon is enough beside a hot bhakri — and that is exactly how it is meant to be eaten.
products.khandeshNote: Khandesh is known for flavours that do not apologise for themselves. This jar carries that character honestly, the way it has always been made at home.

products.name: Fasting / Upvas Mango Loncha
products.subtitle: Khandeshi Mango Loncha
products.tagline: A special mango preparation created for those looking to enjoy mango loncha during fasting.
products.ingredientNote: Prepared without onion, garlic, asafoetida, mustard, fenugreek or turmeric, and with rock salt instead of common salt. Fasting practices differ from family to family — please read the ingredient list and decide what suits yours.
products.tasteNote: Simpler and cleaner than the everyday jars. Without mustard and fenugreek, the mango itself comes forward, with cumin and pepper for warmth rather than heat.
products.khandeshNote: Made because a fasting day should not mean a plain plate. The same mangoes, the same hands, a shorter list of spices.
